description: 8 zero-keyword / behavioral localization tasks across the 10,015-file, 80+ package vercel/ai monorepo

tasks.query: prevents an AI model from smuggling data via fabricated links by checking that a target URL appeared in human user messages rather than assistant or tool outputs, stripping trailing punctuation and fragments
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that prevents an AI model from smuggling data out via fabricated links by checking that a target link actually appeared in human-authored conversation turns rather than assistant or tool outputs, stripping trailing punctuation and fragments before whole-link comparison.

tasks.query: wraps a tool-approval policy in a non-blocking observation mode so policy verdicts are emitted via callback while allowing calls through until enforcement is enabled
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that wraps a tool-approval policy in a non-blocking observation mode so policy verdicts are recorded via a callback while always letting calls proceed until enforcement is explicitly enabled.

tasks.query: authenticates incoming event delivery requests using HMAC SHA-256 over a timestamped payload prefix, rejecting stale deliveries older than five minutes and supporting rotated signing keys
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that authenticates incoming event delivery requests using HMAC over a timestamped payload prefix, rejecting stale deliveries older than five minutes and supporting multiple rotated signing keys.

tasks.query: guards remote downloads against SSRF by blocking private IPv4/IPv6 ranges and local or internal hostnames while allowing inline data URIs and stripping trailing hostname dots
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that guards remote downloads against SSRF by blocking private IPv4/IPv6 ranges and local/internal hostnames while allowing inline data URIs and stripping trailing hostname dots.

tasks.query: single-pass state-machine scanner over a truncated JSON string that auto-closes unfinished strings, objects, arrays, and literals
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that performs a single-pass state-machine scan over a truncated JSON string to auto-close unfinished strings, objects, arrays, and literals so it can be parsed cleanly.

tasks.query: exposes a single outer ReadableStream into which inner streams can be dynamically appended sequentially, pausing pulls until the next inner stream arrives or the outer stream closes
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that exposes a single outer ReadableStream into which inner streams can be dynamically appended one after another, pausing pulls until the next inner stream arrives or the outer stream closes.

tasks.query: searches a text buffer for either a complete target substring or the longest suffix at the end of the buffer that matches a prefix of the target split across stream chunks
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that searches a text buffer for either a complete target substring or the longest suffix at the end of the buffer that could be the start of that substring split across chunks.

tasks.query: deterministically serializes arbitrary nested objects by sorting keys recursively before computing a URL-safe base64 SHA-256 content hash
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that deterministically serializes arbitrary nested objects by sorting object keys recursively before computing a URL-safe base64 SHA-256 content hash.
